List the agent's terminal UIs and the shells running in a sandbox, or quit one


## Usage

```sh
codeflower terminals [SANDBOX] [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--close string` |  | quit the terminal UI or shell with this id, or a chat's terminal UI by its key |
| `--json` |  | print JSON |
